# Node reference

Every plugin the build makes, and what each of its args is for.

**Generated by `scripts/dspnodes`.** Do not edit: run
`cmake --build build --target nodes` after changing any of a
plugin's `setArgDesc`, `setArgRange`, `setArgUnits`,
`setArgDefault` or `setArgValues` calls, or its `setDesc`. CI
regenerates it and fails if the two differ, so the reference
cannot go stale.

**Dir** is `in` for an arg a .dsp may write or wire, `out` for one
the plugin writes, and `state` for scratch it keeps between windows
-- a delay line's ring, an envelope's position. State is listed for
completeness; it is not a port and nothing may wire it.

**Default** is what the callback treats a 0 in that arg as meaning,
where it treats one specially at all. **Range** is the span the
callback is defined over, which for a filter is the span its
coefficients stay stable across -- not a control's travel, which is
the .dsp's business. An empty cell is a plugin that has not said.

The composer modules under `plugins/composer` and the visualizers
under `plugins/visual` are not nodes and are not here; see
GEN_FORMAT.md and VISUALIZERS.md.

### osc::multisined

Sums a sine and detuned ramps

| Arg | Dir | Description | Default | Range | Units | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `waves` | in | How many partials to sum |  |  |  |  |
| `out` | out | The sum of the partials |  |  | full scale |  |
| `sync` | out | Allocated but never written |  |  |  |  |
| `last` | state |  |  |  |  |  |
| `freqbuffer` | state |  |  |  |  |  |
| `freq` | in | Frequency of the first partial |  |  | Hz |  |
| `amp` | in | Peak amplitude of the first partial | 1 | 0 to 1 | full scale |  |
| `detunefreq` | in | How fast the detune alternates across the partials |  |  |  |  |
| `detuneamt` | in | How far a partial may sit from freq |  |  | ratio |  |
| `ampmul` | in | Partial j is this to the power of j times amp |  |  | ratio |  |
| `ampadd` | in | ...plus this times j |  |  | ratio |  |

### osc::simple

Complex Oscillator

| Arg | Dir | Description | Default | Range | Units | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `freq` | in | Frequency |  |  | Hz |  |
| `amp` | in | Peak amplitude | 1 | 0 to 1 | full scale |  |
| `pw` | in | Pulse width: how much of the cycle is the first half | 0.5 | 0 to 1 |  |  |
| `waveform` | in | Which wave |  |  |  | 0 = Sine, 1 = Sawtooth, 2 = Square, 3 = Triangle, 4 = Half-circle, 5 = Parabola |
| `fm` | in | FM Input |  | -1 to 1 | full scale |  |
| `fmamt` | in | Modulation amount |  |  | samples |  |
| `reset` | in | Reset position to 0 when this goes to 1 |  | 0 to 1 |  |  |
| `mul` | in | Multiply the frequency by this | 1 |  | ratio |  |
| `out` | out | The wave |  | -1 to 1 | full scale |  |
| `sync` | out | Output a 1 when the wave begins its cycle |  | 0 to 1 |  |  |
| `last` | state |  |  |  |  |  |

### osc::window

Unipolar oscillator, for windowing

| Arg | Dir | Description | Default | Range | Units | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `freq` | in | Frequency |  |  | Hz |  |
